subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` grow a first-class cross-channel account/auth-profile selector for provider-backed models, and what shared contract should Discord, Telegram, and future channel pickers implement?
rationale: The lower-level auth-profile machinery exists, but choosing how account choices appear, persist, interact with `/model ...@profile`, and preserve compatibility across channel callbacks is product and upgrade policy.

options.title: Define shared picker contract
options.body: Add one shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists, active-profile display, and precedence against typed session pins.

options.title: Keep typed commands only
options.body: Decide that `/model ...@profile`, `/model status`, and CLI auth-order commands remain the supported account-switching path and close or defer picker UX work.

options.title: Pilot one channel first
options.body: Approve a narrower experiment in one channel while documenting that other channel pickers stay unchanged until the shared contract is accepted.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker contract
recommendation.body: Add one shared account/profile picker model consumed by supported channel pickers, including compatible profile lists, active-profile display, and precedence against typed session pins.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans auth/provider UX, session state, and channel picker contracts, and this owner has the strongest sampled history across those areas.
